description: This is a unit test class for the FeatureDeleted class, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation.

classes.name: FeatureDeletedTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the FeatureDeleted class, verifying immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor behaviors.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the FeatureDeleted class is immutable and that its associated Feature class is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hash code and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating a FeatureDeleted instance with a null string ThingId throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating a FeatureDeleted instance with a null ThingId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that creating a FeatureDeleted instance with a null feature ID throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JSON structure.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests that a FeatureDeleted instance can be correctly constructed from valid JSON.
